# boundary_app_token (Resource)

The app token resource allows you to configure a Boundary app_token. App tokens are immutable once created; any change to a field will destroy and recreate the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Block List, Min: 1) The app token permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permissions))
- `scope_id` (String) The scope ID of the app token.
- `time_to_live_seconds` (Number) The time-to-live of the app token, in seconds.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The app token description.
- `name` (String) The app token name. Must be unique within the scope, if provided.
- `time_to_stale_seconds` (Number) The app token must be used within this many seconds, reset each time the token is used. Set to 0 for no timeout. Defaults to no timeout.

### Read-Only

- `approximate_last_access_time` (String) The approximate time the app token was last used.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) The ID of the user that created the app token.
- `expiration_time` (String) The time the app token expires.
- `id` (String) The ID of the app token.
- `status` (String) The current status of the app token (active, expired, stale, or revoked).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The app token value. Only populated at creation time.

<a id="nestedblock--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `grant_scopes` (List of String) The grant scopes for this permission.
- `grants` (List of String) The grants for this permission.

Optional:

- `label` (String) The label for this permission

Read-Only:

- `deleted_scopes` (List of Object) Scopes that were directly granted to this permission but have since been deleted. Populated by the server; read-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--deleted_scopes))
